openings.claim: Adaptive two-step adjudication may expose complementary rows missed by independent threshold-impact ranking, supporting further evaluation with the same allowance. Replace individual ranking with ordered accessible, comparative-gain-relevant flag pairs; carry a branching selection ledger and paired gain/slice bounds.
openings.discriminator: Nearest rival: G0085:R1 targeted single-row ranking. Compare supported decisions, remaining gain/slice bounds, adjudications consumed and elapsed time. Complementarity may resolve cases the rival leaves unresolved. Equal resolution, greater consumption without tighter relevant bounds, or exceeding seventy minutes defeats advantage; none observed.
openings.probe: Using only supplied records/labels, score each first row by worst-case remaining acceptance ambiguity after its best second row, branching over supplied possibilities; identifier tie-breaks; replan after each returned label. Confirm admissible possibilities before selecting, otherwise freeze unresolved. Run against incumbent on matched copies, each with reset sixteen-adjudication allowance and seventy-minute limit. Apply identical four preselected withheld rows; log unavailable attempts without charging allowance. Log every selection, returned label, unavailable attempt and computation time. Advance only if every remaining permissible completion has total gain >=4 and every slice loss <=2; reject only if none meets both; otherwise unresolved. Freeze both reports before opening full-label decision key; compare support, affected slices, accounting and consumption. Workflow probe, not deployment evidence.
openings.uncertainty: Supplied possibilities must suffice; invent none. Branching/bound-recomputation feasibility is unproved; stopping caps do not establish it. Accessible flags may lack complementary effects; identical baseline/candidate predictions cannot alter comparative gain. Withholding or remaining ambiguity may force unresolved.

lineage.reason: Retains causal selection change, rival, full defeat conditions, probe, declared uncertain fit and resource/label caveats.

decision: Retain as untested, feasibility-uncertain. Eighty supplied examples/four slices and twenty-four flags bound the task. Provisional gain six, a slice losing two with nine flags, and greatest improvement overlapping greatest annotator disagreement do not establish acceptance.
